title: Assessing the Feasibility of a Multi-Site Mindfulness Intervention With Sheltered Homeless Youth
official: Assessing the Feasibility of a Multi-Site .b4me Mindfulness Intervention With Sheltered Homeless Youth
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the fidelity of conducting an attention control trial of .b4me with participants recruited from 3 sites: Houston, Texas; New Orleans, Louisiana; and Atlanta, Georgia , to examine feasibility of recruiting and retaining participants across 3 sites and group assignment at 3- and 6-month follow-up and to evaluate the feasibility of collecting outcome measures at 3- and 6-month follow-up.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Youth receiving services at one of the recruitment sites in Houston, Texas area at the time of enrollment
* English speaking
* Able to participate for the entire study period (i.e., not moving during the study)

Exclusion Criteria:

* illiterate as evidenced by a score \< 4 on the REALM health literacy assessment
* severe, untreated mental illness symptoms
